bio.text: Mitchell Jacob is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia reports he was born in Tulsa, served in the U.S. Army from 2017 to 2022, and has worked as a stockbroker, banker, mortgage loan originator and public defender.
He earned an associate degree from Rio Salado College in 2016, a bachelor's degree from Grand Canyon University in 2019, and a law degree from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2025.
